note: Enriches indicators associated with an Intel Requirement (PIR) via Polarity integrations, summarizes enrichment text with CAL Doc Analysis, writes a Description attribute, and tags enrichment:polarity.

params.label: Intel Requirement ID
params.name: pir_id
params.note: ThreatConnect Intel Requirement (PIR) id whose associated indicators will be enriched.

params.label: ThreatConnect Owner
params.name: tc_owner
params.note: Owner used when fetching and updating indicators.

params.label: Polarity Base URL
params.name: polarity_base_url
params.note: Base URL for the Polarity API (e.g. https://polarity.example.com).

params.label: Polarity API Key
params.name: polarity_api_key
params.note: Bearer token for Polarity API authentication.

params.label: Result Limit
params.name: result_limit
params.note: Maximum number of indicators to fetch for the PIR (default 1000).
